performance.launch_note: One observation from launch request to discovered window, including tool overhead; not a benchmark.

idle_sample.context: After multiple song log runs and save tests; no playback or dialog. One local snapshot, not a performance guarantee.

notes: All playback checks used the original EXE with log-only mode enabled; no real game playback was tested.
Expected durations are the player's preview values and exclude the 3-second countdown; they are not measured audio timing.
The original player clears its log when LineCount exceeds 150. Completion was observed for all three songs; retained text is not a complete event audit for longer songs.
Countdown cancellation could not be verified within the 3-second interval using the observed interaction cadence. This is not a recorded player failure.
Raw UI evidence remains local because file dialogs and score text must not be redistributed.
